FluxCap builds software for lawyers handling complex legal cases, starting with antitrust. The Forward Deployed Software Engineer works directly with lawyers and legal engineers to understand their needs, build and improve software workflows, and bring projects from initial conversations through production.
Computer Software
No H1B
Responsibilities
Work with lawyers and legal engineers to understand a problem and choose a useful first step
Build frontend and backend features, data integrations, and AI workflows
Write tested, dependable software and handle sensitive case information with care
Watch how lawyers use what you ship, troubleshoot problems, and improve it with their feedback
Help turn needs from individual cases into product capabilities other legal teams can use
Qualification
Software Development
TypeScript
JavaScript
React
Large Language Models
Information Retrieval
Required
Experience building working software through a job, internship, open-source contribution, or substantial project. There is no minimum years-of-experience requirement
Strong programming fundamentals and familiarity with TypeScript/JS, a frontend framework such as React
Clear communication, curiosity about how people work, and a willingness to ask questions when something is unclear
An ability to break a problem into manageable steps, seek feedback, and follow through
Care for correctness and a willingness to test assumptions, especially when working with AI
You must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not currently able to sponsor visas
Preferred
Experience with LLMs, retrieval, or evaluation frameworks is a plus
Benefits
Meaningful equity.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) with an employer match.
Company-paid life insurance and short-term disability.
Learning and professional development budget.
Hybrid role based in New York City, with some expectation of travel to customer sites.
